svg.title: Two labelled diagrams using a sugar dissolving experiment: honest reporting and including all data
svg.desc: Left: a bar chart of dissolving times where the 40 degree result is slower than the predicted dashed line, and is reported anyway. Right: a results table where an odd 58 second result stays in the table.
svg.text: Odd result stays in the table

g.text: Keep every result in the table
